skill.displayName: 门诊收费与退费日结核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: The local checker code is readable and offline, but the skill needs Review because it embeds mandatory paid-upgrade purchase and installation instructions that conflict with its no-payment/no-network framing.

dimensions.detail: Read and Bash are proportionate for running a local checker over user-supplied business data, but the external purchase endpoints, redirect URL, and paid installation workflow expand the environment and account impact beyond routine reconciliation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The bundled artifact has no dependency manifest and the checked scripts use Node standard-library code only, but the instructions direct installation of external onboarding and paid skill components after purchase.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs agents to mention the free/paid choice on every invocation and, if the user selects paid, complete an external SkillPay purchase/install flow. Although it says the user must confirm payment and that free results must not be withheld, this account-affecting workflow is under-disclosed relative to the top-level no-payment/no-network description.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The bundled code does not create persistence, services, hooks, or background workers, but the documented paid path asks the agent to install additional skills/dependencies, which is persistent environment mutation and should be explicitly user-controlled.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core capability is a coherent local outpatient cashier daily reconciliation checker, but the skill also requires agents to present and carry out a paid upgrade path, including payment-link generation and paid skill installation, which is not necessary for the local checking purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a free local checker that also contains built-in paid-upgrade instructions. Do not allow an agent to open purchase links, install external SkillPay/onboarding components, or start a payment flow unless you explicitly ask for that and verify the merchant, product, amount, and install source yourself.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Upheld in part: the actual checker is local and offline, but the top-level description says no payment and no network while SKILL.md and CLI output advertise external purchase and install paths.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Upheld: the skill includes commercial upsell, payment-routing, JSON endpoint, and redirect mechanics that are not needed to run the free local checker.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Upheld: account/payment and installation side effects are present in later instructions rather than clearly disclosed near the basic usage section.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded after inspection: scripts/run.mjs exists locally and was fully inspected; it reads input, invokes the bundled engine, and prints results, with no hidden remote execution found.
[P9] unexpected: Downgraded: the blank-line padding is unnecessary, but manual inspection found no hidden instructions after it beyond the visible optional full-version section.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded as a security concern: the Chinese interface matches the Chinese domain, field names, examples, and target workflow, though clearer locale documentation would help.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Confirmed as a minor quality issue: one comment mentions contract text, but the runtime behavior and user-facing usage are for cashier daily reconciliation forms.
